translations.web: The cities shall be for your refuge from the avenger, that the man slayer not die until he stands before the congregation for judgment.
translations.bsb: You are to have these cities as a refuge from the avenger, so that the manslayer will not die until he stands trial before the assembly.
translations.kjv: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.
translations.asv: And the cities shall be unto you for refuge from the avenger, that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation for judgment.
